title: Group-Valued Lévy Processes with Type-II Arveson Systems
exact_target: Find a group-valued Lévy process with a type-II product system, including the suggested case of circle homeomorphisms.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001188 (OWR-3392-016). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Product Systems and Independence in Quantum Dynamics (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2009/09, pp. 493--548; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 53, printed page 545; Floricel--Wadel publisher abstract/introduction and Theorems 5.1--5.2 summaries accessed 2026-10-11.
Floricel--Wadel 2025; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.
R. Floricel and P. Wadel, Product systems arising from Lévy processes, Journal of Functional Analysis 289 (2025), article 111087; primary publisher abstract/introduction consulted.

status_qualification: Freshly consulted primary publication evidence gives a positive answer to the broad group-valued existence question: Floricel--Wadel construct type-II_infinity systems from infinite-dimensional Banach-space-valued pure-jump Lévy processes, and an additive Banach space is a topological group. This does not answer the narrower suggested homeomorphism-group example. The saved partially_solved status is retained as provenance rather than changed.
